title: ROOF CENTER SUPPORT
summary: Coupe (19437) body weld: the front roof center support (the T-top center bar / T-bar front section), upper and lower halves, which are spotwelded together and to the roof bow center outer and the upper windshield frame. A bonding strip is riveted on top along the car centerline over a plastisol sealer bead, and clips are riveted on for the roof panels.

parts.name: SUPPORT ASM-FRT ROOF CTR UPPER
parts.name_expanded: Support assembly – front roof center upper (T-top center bar)

parts.name: SUPPORT-FRT ROOF CTR LOWER
parts.name_expanded: Support – front roof center lower (T-top center bar)

materials.where: 3/16 dia bead on top of support [1] along the car centerline, under bonding strip [3] (main view)

fastening.note: Spotweld (weld 1A). Weld one at the center and one at each end first, then the remaining 17.
Arc or gas weld (weld 1C). Tack welds .50 long. View B.
Spotweld (weld 1D). View A, at the rear end of the support.

fastening.to: top of support [1] at the car centerline
fastening.note: Rivets [2] go down through the bonding strip [3] (3 holes shown) into the support; sealer 52c bead underneath.
View B: rivets [2] go down through .192/.199 dia holes drilled through the inner frame asm.
Clips [4] (four shown along the support flanges) held by rivets [5] driven up from below.
3/16 dia bead of plastisol sealer under the bonding strip.
